questions.en: Describe the reactivity of Group 2 elements with water and dilute hydrochloric acid. Provide relevant chemical equations and differences in their reactivity.
Explain the thermal decomposition of carbonates and nitrates of Group 2 elements. Give reason and relative order of the ease of thermal stability.
Explain the solubility of sulphates and hydroxides of Group 2 elements, and discuss the trend in their solubility down the group with appropriate examples.
Explain the process of extraction of Mg through Dow's method.
Explain the factors that determine the specific geometry (shape) of a transition metal complex.
Describe the splitting of d orbitals and colour formation in octahedral and tetrahedral complexes.
Compare the reactions of conc. HCl with aqueous Cu2+ and aqueous Co2+. Include equations, colour/geometry changes, and the reason for different colours.
Explain the stereoisomerism with its types in transition metal complexes.
Describe the various redox reactions that take place in transition metal complex ions?
Explain the difference between homolytic and heterolytic fissions of a covalent bond.
Discuss cis-trans isomerism. Explain with two examples.
Describe the phenomenon of optical activity. Explain with an example.
What is the difference between racemic mixture and meso compound? Draw the structures of enantiomers and meso form of tartaric acid.
Discuss the properties and trends of Group 2 elements from Be to Ba.
Describe the chemical reactions of Group 2 metals with oxygen, including reaction conditions, flame colors, and the trend in basicity of their oxides.
Explain the reaction trends of Group 2 metals with cold water and steam, including relevant chemical equations and the basicity trend of their hydroxides.
Detail the general reaction of Group 2 metals with dilute acids HCl and H2SO4. Compare the behaviors of Be, Mg, and Ca, including chemical equations and specific limitations.
Provide a detailed comparison between Group 1 (Alkali Metals) and Group 2 (Alkaline Earth Metals).
Explain complex ion formation in Group 2 elements. Discuss the factors influencing complex stability, give examples of hydrated ions, and describe the applications of EDTA complexes.
Describe the industrial preparation of quicklime from limestone. Explain the calcination process, reaction conditions, equilibrium control, and major industrial applications.
Explain the role and applications of Group 2 compounds in Construction and Environmental Protection.
Discuss in detail how Group 2 elements and their compounds are utilized in Medicine and Agriculture.
Explain the electronic configuration of the first-row 3d transition series.
Describe the general physical and chemical characteristics of 3d transition metals.
What are variable oxidation states? Discuss why first-row (3d) transition elements exhibit variable oxidation states and explain the parabolic trend observed across the series.
Explain the mechanism of catalytic action of transition metals in both homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysis with suitable examples.
Define transition metal complexes and ligands. Explain the classification of ligands based on their charge and denticity with suitable examples.
Explain how the formula and charge of a complex ion are predicted. Differentiate between cationic, anionic, and neutral complexes using suitable examples.
Explain Crystal Field Splitting of d-orbitals in transition metal complexes. Compare and contrast d-orbital splitting patterns in octahedral and tetrahedral complexes with diagrammatic descriptions.
Explain in detail the ligand exchange reactions of Copper(II) complexes.
Explain in detail the ligand exchange reactions of Cobalt(II) complexes.

Define the stability constant (Kstab) of complex ions and explain how its expression is derived using the reaction of hexaaquacoppper(II) with chloride ions and describe the "chelating effect" with a suitable reaction example.

Define stereoisomerism in transition metal complexes and explain cis-trans (geometric) isomerism in both square planar and octahedral complexes with suitable examples. Furthermore, discuss the medical significance, molecular polarity, and mechanism of action of cisplatin as an anti-cancer drug.

Explain the concept of optical isomerism in transition metal complexes. Define enantiomers, dextrorotatory, and laevorotatory forms, and describe how octahedral complexes containing bidentate ligands exhibit optical isomerism.
Describe the process for deriving the balanced redox equation between acidified manganate(VII) ions and ethanedioate ions.
Describe the feasibility of the redox reaction between acidified manganate(VII) ions and iron(II) ions.
Construct the overall ionic equation for the reaction that takes place between Cu2+ and I- ions.
